origin: Schema-derived synthetic inputs written for Confidex. They are not captured exports from installed vendor applications.

onepassword.observed: Official example contains concealed with guarded=false. Concealed must remain secret.

bitwarden.format: Plain export JSON with encrypted=false; no schema version field

keepass_published_export.format: KeePass2 XML test export, published by KeePassXC
keepass_published_export.observed: UserName has ProtectInMemory=True. Its Value is plaintext. The file also contains ordinary unmarked Password values and binary references.

keepass_implementation.observed: ProtectInMemory marks plaintext in an export; Protected marks inner-stream encrypted base64. These must not be treated as the same encoding.

csv.format: Generic UTF-8 BOM, comma, header, CRLF; explicit positional mapping
csv.origin: Confidex synthetic dialect fixture. This does not certify Chrome, Firefox or Apple export compatibility.

validation_limits: No vendor application roundtrip was run: bw, op and keepassxc-cli are not installed.
Expected Records are semantic golden fixtures, not export byte-roundtrip promises.
KDBX, encrypted Bitwarden and browser CSV export captures belong to their format adapters.
